sarah: Heads-up — vendor T-Systems notified a manifest change for APAC rack shipment (P.O. 4782). ETA pushed from 2026-04-08 to 2026-04-15. Only 60% of racks cleared customs so far.
omar: Ugh. Any reason? freight or customs?
sarah: Carrier says 'inspection hold' + missing serial mappings. Carrier message: "Delay pending re-documentation" :frowning:
omar: Can we ask for partial deconsolidation? We need at least 4 racks for APAC Dedicated onboarding next week.
liam: @omar @sarah if we get 4 racks we can hot-stage them in sg-edge and bump the customer canaries. Do we have PO split info?
sarah: PO 4782 split: 10 racks total, vendor shipped 6 (mixed SKU A/B). We reserved 8 for Dedicated commits. :eyes:
sophie: That conflicts with the joint announcement scheduled for 4/12. Marketing already set the date.
viktor: I'll ping the vendor contact (Marcel) for priority rework. If they can't, recommend pushing 2 racks from EU pool to APAC as temporary swap.
omar: What's the lead time to swap? network/transport?
liam: Cross-region move = ~72h plus customs. Faster if we reassign from EU spare inventory in our cloud marketplace partners — requires marketplace approval.
sarah: Action: viktor to request vendor priority and serial mappings (ETA 2h). omar to check customs broker options. liam to confirm hot-stage checklist. sophie to hold the announcement till noon PT 4/11 if no certainty. :thumbsup:
carrier-bot: Shipment 4782 status updated: INSPECTION_HOLD -> DOCUMENTS_REQUESTED. Link: https://carrier.example/4782
sarah: Thanks — keep updates here. If vendor can't prioritize, we go EU->APAC swap plan. Avoid breaking customer SLAs.
